text:
ntohl
Description
Convert the unsigned integer from network byte order to host byte
order.
Syntax
ntohl
<
netlong
>
ntohl <netlong>
Convert the unsigned integer from network byte order to host byte
order.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
set
netlong
12345678
set
hostlong
[
ntohl
$netlong
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
,
GLOBAL_GTM
